description: 農田水利署各管理處歷年實際灌溉用水量統計 [irrigation] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 提供資料包括：處別、年別、灌溉用水量億噸、期作、資料建立時間等欄位資料。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv, xml. The portal shows 2025-06-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
